pages.text: By RagingRevenge. Magic resources, crops, loops and miners.
$(l)BotaniaResourceAutomation$(): drops items in a full Mana Pool (redstone 15), stocking by drawer. 4 labels.
$(l)FluidTransfer-BM$(): life essence from the Altar to tanks, and Twilight matter. 7 labels.
$(l)StarlightGeneration$(): fills a starlight tank up to a limit. 4 labels.
$(l)AgricraftFarming$(): powers the Hydrator, Harvester and Crafter. 4 labels.
$(l)MysticalCrafters$(): essence to six crafters on a pulse. Its empty-crafter check names a mod not in this pack, so it always passes. 11 labels.
$(l)MysticalItemMovement$(): moves essences from the Harvester. 3 labels.
$(l)MythicMiners$(): miner output to drawers every 320 ticks. 2 labels.
$(l)EmcLoop$(): arcanium to an EMC crafter on a redstone pulse. 2 labels.
$(l)NetherStarLoop$(): nether stars and redstone blocks through a crafter. 4 labels. Needs a fix, see the next page.

$(l)NetherStarLoop$() won't compile as published: the first $(5)Every Tick$() block has no $(5)End$(). Add a line with $(5)End$() right after $(5)To Crafter$(), before $(5)Every Redstone Pulse Do$(). With that change it passes SFM's parser.
